E1.evidence: Issue #3103 links failing CI jobs and gives the assertion log: "test_robot_state: /home/runner/work/moveit2/moveit2/.work/target_ws/src/moveit2/moveit_core/robot_state/src/robot_state.cpp:1309: const Eigen::Isometry3d& moveit::core::RobotState::getFrameInfo(const std::string&, const moveit::core::LinkModel*&, bool&) const: Assertion `checkLinkTransforms()' failed."; PR #3105 identifies the cause.

E2.evidence: The failing code is a unit test in moveit_core/robot_state/test/robot_state_test.cpp that queries a freshly constructed RobotState without updating its link transforms; the assert that catches it is compiled only in Debug builds. Both the test and the RobotState implementation belong to the same package (moveit_core), so there is no second separately deployable unit, and the misuse would occur with any build of the library. PR #3105: "Fixes #3103 by ensuring that the `dirty_link_transforms_` member is cleared before querying the `RobotState`"; "Setting the build type to Release causes tests to silently fail, whereas Debug does not (some tests rely on assert calls, which are enabled / disabled based on the presence of the `NDBUG` macro variable, which is set by CMake depending on the build type)." The fix adds state.setToDefaultValues(); state.updateLinkTransforms(); to the test. Additional context: The issue title says rigidlyAttachedParent but the failing test is OneRobot.rigidlyConnectedParent. The CI dependence is on CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE (Debug in the SonarScan job via industrial_ci, Release elsewhere), which is a build-configuration difference, not an interface. Fix merged on main (#3105, f20265a5a2551b3270373d6ff6925c1299adc6c6) and backported to humble (#3107, c6a38fa6382a637149a58309cc1da8808817aaa2) and iron (#3108, 90f8de0dd6c0fbe7fc2fe193a3329aa6dc029a97). #3102 is referenced for more explanation.
